notes: SBI does **not publish official cutoff marks** for the Junior Associate (Clerk) exam. Unlike RRB NTPC, no state-wise or category-wise cutoff table is released with the prelims or mains results: the official result PDFs list **roll numbers only**, and marks are made available only to individual candidates through the official scorecard pages after each result. The rows below therefore record what is officially known for the last two completed cycles, not numbers. Any website showing a state-wise SBI Clerk cutoff table is publishing an **unofficial estimate**; treat it with caution and rely on the official result pages and your own scorecard. Cutoff marks, where the Bank defines them, are simply the marks of the last candidate called for a particular stage.
